mapper.sql: v . id ,v.video_id videoId, v.activity_id activityId,v.user_id userId, v.ctime, v.type, v.status, v.like_count likeCount, v.view_count viewCount, v.comment_count commentCount
c . activity_id activityId,c.creator_id userId, c.ctime, c.category type, c.view_count viewCount, c.like_count likeCount
mapper.select:
select
from corgi_vlog v left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = v.user_id where v.ctime <=#{ctime} and v.user_id != #{userId}
and d.group in (select `group` from user_prefer_group where user_id = #{userId})
order by like_count desc limit 20

select h.activity_id activityId, c.creator_id userId from corgi_vlog_hot h left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.activity_id = h.activity_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = c.creator_id where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{userId} and h.activity_id = f.feed) and h.expect_view > h.view_count and h.status = 'open' and h.type = 'auto' and (d.group is null or d.group = '' or not exists(select `group` from corgi_prefer_group where user_id = #{userId}) or d.group in (select `group` from corgi_prefer_group where user_id = #{userId})) order by h.like_count desc limit #{size}

select
from corgi_activity_creator c left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = c.creator_id
left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = c.creator_id
where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{vlog.userId} and f.feed = c.activity_id) and c.creator_id != #{vlog.userId} and c.check_status != 'fail'
and (d.group is null or d.group = '' or d.group in ('${vlog.type}'))
and p.city = #{city}
order by c.id desc limit #{size}

select
from corgi_activity_like l join corgi_activity_creator c on l.activity_id = c.activity_id where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{vlog.userId} and f.feed = c.activity_id) and l.type = 'real' and l.user_id != #{vlog.userId} and c.category in ('image','text','video') and c.check_status = 'normal'
and l.like_user_id in (select co_user_id from corgi_user_coordinate where user_id = #{vlog.userId})
and l.like_user_id in (select follow_user_id from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{vlog.userId})
order by l.id desc limit #{size}

select l2.activity_id from corgi_activity_like l1 left join corgi_activity_like l2 on l1.like_user_id = l2.like_user_id and l2.activity_id != l1.activity_id and l2.type = 'real' left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.activity_id = l2.activity_id where c.category in ('video' , 'image' , 'text') and l1.type = 'real' and l1.like_user_id != #{userId} and l1.activity_id = #{activityId} and c.check_status = 'normal' group by l2.activity_id order by count (1) desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select
from corgi_vlog_hot h join corgi_activity_creator c on h.activity_id = c.activity_id
left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = c.creator_id
where not exists(select 1 from corgi_feed_${index} f where f.user_id = #{vlog.userId} and h.activity_id = f.feed) and h.expect_view > h.view_count and h.status = 'open' and h.type = #{vlog.type} and c.creator_id != #{vlog.userId} and c.category in('image','video','text') and c.check_status != 'fail'
and (d.group is null or d.group = '' or d.group in ('${vlog.activityId}'))
order by h.ctime desc
order by h.like_count desc
limit #{size}

select
from corgi_vlog v where v.user_id in (select follow_user_id from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId}) order by v.id desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select count(1) from corgi_vlog;

select
from corgi_vlog v limit #{start},1;
select activity_id from corgi_vlog_hot v limit #{start}, 1;
select count(1) from corgi_vlog where ctime like concat(#{date}, '%')

select count(1) id, sum(v.like_count) likeCount, sum(view_count) viewCount, sum(comment_count) commentCount from corgi_vlog v left join corgi_activity_topic t on t.activity_id = v.activity_id where t.topic = #{topic}
